Bug_Title: Se: Method must be private in order for serialization to work (SE_METHOD_MUST_BE_PRIVATE)
Bug_Explanation: The bug was embedded in the generated code by making the writeObject and readObject methods private. This ensures that the methods are only accessible within the class and cannot be modified from outside, which is necessary for serialization to work correctly.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case triggers the bug by serializing an object of class SeBug using the ObjectOutputStream's writeObject() method, which calls the custom writeObject() method in SeBug. The custom method is not declared private, which violates the rule that the serialization/deserialization API must be private in order for serialization to work.
